title: Social Media Agency in Miami
metaTitle: Social Media Agency in Miami, FL | TDM
metaDescription: Social media management for Miami businesses: strategy, content, short video, community replies and paid social, planned around the city's audiences and seasons.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) plans, produces and manages social media for Miami businesses on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. Miami is one of the most visual, most photographed cities in the country, and people here choose restaurants, gyms, apartments and clinics by what they see on a phone. We give a business a steady, recognisable presence there and look after the people who respond to it.

sections.heading: A city that decides on Instagram and TikTok
paragraphs: In many places social media supports the sale. In Miami it often is the sale. A diner picks a Wynwood restaurant from a reel of the food. A renter tours an Edgewater apartment through a video before calling. A visitor saves a list of beach clubs and rooftop bars weeks before the flight. If your account looks abandoned, or looks like stock photography, those people move on to the next one.

The audience is mixed in ways that affect every post. Some followers are residents who will come back every week, some are seasonal residents here for the winter, and others are visitors who will come once. A follower in Brickell and one in Kendall live in different versions of the city. A content plan has to decide which of those groups each post is for.

sections.heading: What social media management covers
paragraphs: We start with a strategy: which platforms, which audiences, what you want followers to do. Then we run the accounts month by month.
bullets: A monthly content calendar, agreed with you before anything is published.
Content creation by our media team: graphics, photo edits, captions and short vertical video.
Community management: replies to comments, direct messages and reviews.
Paid social campaigns that put the posts that already perform in front of more of the right people.
A report on reach, engagement, enquiries and what we will change next month.

sections.heading: Planning around Miami's calendar
paragraphs: The year here has a rhythm that a content calendar should follow. The winter season fills hotels and restaurants. Art Basel in December turns Miami Beach, Wynwood and the Design District into one long event. The boat show, music festival season in spring, the Grand Prix and Swim Week each bring their own crowd and their own hashtags. Summer is slower, hotter and more local, which makes it a good time for offers aimed at residents.

Hurricane season needs a plan too. When a storm approaches, scheduled promotional posts look careless. We pause them and switch to practical updates about opening hours and closures, which is what followers want from a local business at that moment.

sections.heading: Before you hire someone to run your accounts
paragraphs: Check that you keep ownership of every account and that the agency is added as a manager, never the reverse. Ask who replies to messages and how quickly, since a slow reply to a booking question is a lost booking. Ask who films and photographs the content, who edits it, and how often new material will be captured at your venue.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami. Filming and photography for your accounts are done in the United States by our US-based team, while strategy, design, video editing and community management are handled online by the wider TDM team.

faqs.q: Which social media platforms matter most in Miami?
faqs.a: For consumer businesses, Instagram and TikTok carry the most weight, with Facebook still useful for older and family audiences and for local groups. LinkedIn matters for professional services and B2B. We choose the mix after looking at who your customers are.

faqs.q: How often should a Miami business post on social media?
faqs.a: Often enough to look open and current. Regularity matters more than volume. In the winter season and during big event weeks it pays to post more, and we build that into the calendar ahead of time.

faqs.q: Do you create the content or do we?
faqs.a: We create it. Our US-based team films and photographs your venue, staff and products in the United States, on dates set in the content calendar. Graphics and video editing are then done at our operations office in Lahore. If you already have good footage or photos, we can work those in too.

faqs.q: How much does social media management cost in Miami?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of platforms, how many posts and videos are produced each month and whether paid campaigns and community management are included. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How soon can you start managing our social media?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements and the brief. The start date is agreed in the plan.
